title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory's totally gonna win today! She's top-class when it comes to sprints!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: No way! My money's on that newcomer, Daitaku Helios! She'll set Nakayama ablaze for sure!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo… I'm here to witness the very moment you triumph and reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna put everything you've taught me into this race! I'll pull out all the stops and carve my name into Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Hehe! Just feel that energy in the air! This race is about to be a blast!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey, Bamboo! ☆ Your vibes've got me going, like, whaaaaat!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Helios! As always, you've got me asking "what?" as well!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Daitaku Helios is always bouncing off the walls and saying things I don't understand, but her racing ability is nothing to sneeze at!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You won't believe how ready I am for today! Like, I am locked in! I just know it's gonna be total gas! Can I get a "wahey"?! ☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm assume that means you're excited for the race. That's great, but just so you know…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm here to take my place at the top. That means crushing everyone here, including you! You better be ready!
